# When mail is refused

Every email is checked again at the moment it would be sent, against the state of things then -- not when it was drafted. Every refusal is recorded with its reason. *Temporary* refusals wait and retry. A refusal only because the email's mailbox is switched off moves it to a mailbox that is on, or waits for one. Everything else blocks for good.

| Refusal | Kind | Lifted for a reply? | Lifted for the operator's test? |

## Inbox placement

A mailbox sends cold mail only while at least 70% of its recent inbox tests landed in the inbox, measured within the last 48 hours. Two consecutive days under that on any mailbox rests the whole domain for 14 days.

## Switching cold mail back on

The operator's bar: every measured day at least 80% inbox over 14 days, at least 10 days measured, the domain not resting, the gate clear today. `coldops reactivate` and the CRM's System page check it.
